detail.longDescription: arXiv:2609.30766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) differs from conventional RL in that every task executes inside a complex environment, e.g., a virtual machine or a container. We find that agentic RL pays a heavy environment tax: a large share of the iteration time goes to the environment rather than to learning. The root cause is the lack of a full-lifecycle solution to environment management. We present WeEnv, which manages environments across packaging, initialization, and provisioning. WeEnv packages components as independently published layer groups and composes them at initialization, so that updating a component republishes one small group rather than every artifact containing it. To speed up environment initialization, WeEnv launches environments instantly and fetches contents on demand. During task execution, WeEnv provisions CPU and memory elastically, adjusting each environment's quota from its observed usage to fit the varying demands. WeEnv reduces the initialization by 5.6-14.2x over E2B, Docker, and AgentENV, cutting its share of the iteration time from up to 53.4% to 9.1%. WeEnv is deployed for agentic RL at WeChat.
